headline: Bank of Ghana Posts $780 Million Net Loss, Explains Gold Program Drop
summary: The Bank of Ghana registered an audited net loss of $780 million, stating that a $1.5 billion paper loss on its gold programme resulted from the cedi's 2025 appreciation.
why: Central bank balance sheets in emerging economies are critical indicators for debt sustainability and foreign exchange management.

impacts.name: Ghanaian Cedi
impacts.why: The central bank attributed accounting losses to the cedi's currency gains against the valuation of gold reserves.
